thesis: KNSA is a parabolic, extended name being bought into a risk-off tape (QQQ below 50/200-day, VIX at the 99th percentile). Price sits at the 52-week high, 8% above the SMA20, after a +40.8% 21-day run, and the last two up days came on fading volume (0.79 ratio). Most of the upside is already priced: the stock is within 0.6% of the analyst mean target, and the latest +9% leg followed a sell-side Best Idea note, not company news. Reward/risk is only about 1.7, and the entry zone requires a pullback, so buying now means chasing. A follow-on offering after a ~98% run is a plausible event risk, and unusual options activity with 10% short interest means violent moves can go either way.
